description: okena, a load balancer, reverse proxy and API gateway written in x86-64 assembly (no libc, io_uring), with HttpArena's handler module assembled into the binary (make MODULES=httparena.inc): /baseline sums the query and body, /json/{count} serializes the parsed dataset per request (compressed per request by okena's own gzip/brotli for json-comp), /echo returns the body okena read, /delay/{ms} holds the request on okena's timers without blocking the worker. Static files from okena's own file server with its precompressed .br/.gz. Its own TLS 1.3 / 1.2, HTTP/2 and HTTP/3. HTTP/1.1 on :8080, h1 over TLS on :8081, h2c on :8082, h2 and h3 on :8443.
